title: kOA Cultural Rights Policy Artifact
description: Validates a cultural-rights policy used by kOA components and governance policy bundles. The policy records cultural authority, rights holders, community protocols, audiences, consent, access, reuse, AI restrictions, distribution controls, withdrawal, dissent, review, recourse, enforcement points, provenance, governance approval, receipts, and validation. It is designed for object-, collection-, artifact-, media-, dataset-, and knowledge-level policy without transferring data ownership or granting machine privilege.
$comment: Cross-object checks are performed by docs/tools/validate_docs.py: all authority, subject, community, audience, protocol, policy-bundle, component, artifact, consent-evidence, obligation, test, and evidence references must resolve; every authority and audience reference must be in scope; action rules must align with access, reuse, consent, AI, distribution, withdrawal, and dissent rules; approved-by identities must satisfy separation of duties; active policy must be registered by the artifact-contract index; and policy-bundle activation must remain atomic with rollback or forward repair.
